transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1). At 0400 Beijing's Maritime Safety Administration declared a 'customs quarantine zone' around Taiwan, effective in 48 hours: all vessels must submit to PLA Navy and Coast Guard inspection. The stated pretext is interdicting 'smuggled military contraband.' Overnight a PLAN frigate fired warning shots across the bow of a Taiwanese Coast Guard cutter near Kinmen; no casualties.

Commercial shipping is halting. Lloyd's underwriters are suspending war-risk coverage; semiconductor futures are spiking and Asian markets opened sharply down. Taiwan's president has invoked the Taiwan Relations Act and formally requested US assistance. USS carrier strike group is ~72 hours from the strait. Beijing's Foreign Ministry states that 'any foreign military escort within the quarantine zone will be treated as an act of war.'

Allies are quiet so far. Congressional leaders are demanding a response; the public is divided. You do not know Beijing's true objective. What do you do?

actions.name: gather_intel

params.rationale: We need to know urgently whether this quarantine is coercive diplomacy or the opening phase of kinetic action; IC collection on PLA force posture and Xi’s directives is essential before committing to a response.

actions.rationale: We need to know urgently whether this quarantine is coercive diplomacy or the opening phase of kinetic action; IC collection on PLA force posture and Xi’s directives is essential before committing to a response.

actions.name: sail_csg

params.rationale: Beijing must see that we are prepared to contest the quarantine; ordering the strike group toward the stratum now preserves options and signals resolve even though it is 72 hours out.

actions.rationale: Beijing must see that we are prepared to contest the quarantine; ordering the strike group toward the stratum now preserves options and signals resolve even though it is 72 hours out.

actions.name: rally_allies

params.rationale: A united front with Tokyo, Canberra, Manila and Brussels multiplies pressure on Beijing and prevents adversaries from peeling off partners with economic threats.

actions.name: public_demarche

params.rationale: A formal public demand to lift the quarantine establishes the illegality of the blockade, reassures Taipei, and creates diplomatic space for coalition action.

actions.name: backchannel

params.rationale: Public pressure alone risks entrapment; a secret channel can probe Beijing’s true objectives and offer an off-ramp before shots are exchanged.

actions.name: coordinate_g7_econ

params.rationale: Markets and supply chains are panicking; a coordinated G7 economic response and semiconductor backstop limits Chinese leverage, reassures industry, and shows we are prepared for sustained pressure.

transcript.narrative: The IC surges collection on PLA dispositions. Allied capitals coordinate their messaging with Washington. A G7 chip-supply backstop steadies markets somewhat. Beijing, probing for resolve, finds it -- and recalibrates downward.
